meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Bank credit by state and bank group, total and small borrowal accounts, every quarter since June 2017
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 952 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Amounts in ₹ crore. 18 cells the source prints more than once with different values (2021-06-30, 2017-09-30, 2017-06-30) are left out: we cannot tell which value is right. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (161 values, e.g. All India, Foreign banks, small borrowal accounts, credit limits on 2021-06-01; All India, Private sector banks, small borrowal accounts, credit limits on 2021-06-01; All India, Small finance banks, small borrowal accounts, credit limits on 2021-06-01).
